snippet.title: [GAME PV] Lord Liberty Quest II ~Pure White~
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4330940/

Languages: English , Japanese , Simplified Chinese .

STORY
The "Black Devil" assaults the Disodart Continent every few decades.
Only the priests of the Central Church in the royal capital Gardis are capable of sealing this devil away. And the Magic Hero protects the priests.
However, someone is secretly working to hasten the revival of the "Black Devil."
The entire knight order stationed to monitor the sealing tower has been wiped out.
Taking the situation gravely, the royal capital has decided to entrust the investigation of the tower to a church priestess.
But that priestess turns out to be a young, innocent maiden…

GAMEPLAY
The main story follows a linear progression, yet offers high freedom — explore various locations at your leisure and enjoy the adventure.
From open fields to dungeons and towns, every area is filled with intricate mechanisms and secrets.
The core concept is the thrill and excitement of adventuring, packed with classic JRPG-style presentations and events.

FEATURES
·A prequel to Magical Girl Konoha, allowing you to experience Konoha's adventure from a different perspective.
·Turn-based open-world RPG (Fast travel available)
·Abundant main quests and side quests (includes Additional Scenario Vols. 1–4)
·Dressing system (Priest, maid, magical girl, swimsuit outfits and more available)
